verdict.rationale: Bitbucket does not ship its own native issue tracker with milestones, time tracking, or dependencies; it relies entirely on tight Jira integration (embedded Jira UI, issue-key-linked commits, opening Jira tickets from PRs) to deliver this functionality. missing for 10: evidence of native Bitbucket issue tracking, milestone support, time tracking, and dependency linking within Bitbucket itself (rather than delegated to a separate Jira product), plus independent confirmation of how seamless this cross-product workflow feels in practice.
